title: A specialized population of hair afferents dedicated to transmitting mechanical itch
title_zh: 一类专一的毛发传入纤维专责传递机械性瘙痒
abstract: Hairs serve as sensory structures that are crucial for perceiving environmental cues through interactions with sensory endings. Depigmented and demedullated atypical hairs exhibit a limited distribution on mammalian skin and have not been extensively studied. In this study, we identify a specific type of hair, termed vellus-like hairs (VLHs), which are enriched in the postauricular region and on the hindpaws of mice. These hairs are innervated by Aβ low-threshold mechanoreceptors (LTMRs) that co-express Toll-like receptor 5 and Calbindin1 (TLR5Calb1). Genetic ablation or silencing of these hair afferents eliminated mechanical itch generated by gentle VLH stroking or indentation under both physiological and pathological conditions. Conversely, optogenetic activation of TLR5Calb1 hair afferents evoked itch behaviors. Mechanosensitive Piezo2 channels in TLR5Calb1 Aβ-LTMRs function as key mechanotransducers for mechanical itch signaling. Our study sheds light on the previously poorly understood somatosensory physiology of unique hairs, emphasizing the significant role of TLR5Calb1 Aβ-LTMRs in itch transmission.
abstract_zh: 毛发作为感觉结构，通过与感觉末梢的接触在感知环境线索中至关重要。去色且失去髓鞘的非典型毛发在哺乳动物皮肤中分布有限，且研究不多。我们在此研究中鉴定了一种特定类型的毛发，称为vellus-like hairs (VLHs)，其在小鼠的耳后区和后足中富集。这些毛发由共表达Toll样受体5和Calbindin1（TLR5Calb1）的Aβ低阈值机械感受神经元（low-threshold mechanoreceptors, LTMRs）支配。在生理和病理条件下，遗传性清除或沉默这些毛发传入纤维可消除由轻柔刷动或压迫VLH引发的机械性瘙痒。相反，光遗传激活TLR5Calb1毛发传入纤维可诱发瘙痒行为。TLR5Calb1 Aβ-LTMR中的机械敏感Piezo2通道是机械性瘙痒信号传递的关键机械转导器。本研究阐明了此前鲜有研究的独特毛发体感生理，强调TLR5Calb1 Aβ-LTMR在瘙痒传导中的重要作用。
